model.activation_assumption: gated SiLU / SwiGLU; separate and fused projections are alternatives
model.token_assumption: T is total prefill tokens (batch times length for uniform batches); expert M=T/8 assumes balanced routing
model.attention: 20 SWA layers, 4 global layers; QK/PV attention matmuls are outside this linear-projection benchmark

timing.scope: Preallocated-output GPU GEMM only; includes INT32 group reduction, FP32 scaling/accumulation, BF16 output; excludes input quantization, compilation, tuning, host dispatch and allocation
timing.tuning: Select each backend separately from existing candidates; final measurement uses fresh data and a separate timing pass

inputs.quantization: synthetic already-quantized INT8, uniform integers [-127,127]; no model weights used
